programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Vitorijos „Baskonia“ - Kauno „Žalgiris“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Zalgiris Kaunas - AS Monaco
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: EuroLeague. FC Barcelona - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Within the Channel Country deserts, Indigenous educator Phil Breslin scours the endless sands to find three animals that not only survive the heat but thrive in unrelenting conditions. Get ready to meet Australia's most impressive animals: the perentie, the continent's largest lizard; the emu, its fastest flightless bird; and the mighty red kangaroo, the world's largest marsupial.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. Classic Nat Geo footage is mixed with high-tech graphics, freeze frames and photo finishes to magnify the killer weaponry.

programme.title: Big Cat Games
programme.desc: THE BIG CAT GAMES is a high-end, high-profile television event that pits the world's most ferocious land predators against each other in a series of challenges that will push them to the limits of their athletic abilities.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Kingdom of the White Wolf
programme.desc: Join Ronan Donovan, a National Geographic Explorer and photographer, as he takes the viewer on a unique adventure to track down the hard-to-find Arctic wolf. The series follows the year-long travails of a family of Arctic wolves on Ellesmere Island, from the first breaking light after the long winter, through the life-bringing springtime, the fattening summer months and the preparations of autumn. Each episode deals with different obstacles that the wolves face and have to overcome and, along the way, we the various characters and personalities of the animal family are revealed. The show makes good use of intimate footage to make the viewer feel that they are actually there, observing the creatures up close.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin leaves the Australian mainland to discover which of the island-dwelling animals is truly built to survive. First up, he meets the enigmatic green turtle on the Wellesley Islands. Next, he is on K'Gari (Fraser Island), where he tracks down a pack of the notorious dingoes. Finally, he encounters the formidable and aptly named death adder snake.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin dares into the Australian savannah to find the species most built to survive. First is Australia's largest bird of prey, the majestic but intimidating wedge-tailed eagle. Next, Phil tracks down one of the world's deadliest snakes, the coastal taipan. Finally, Phil faces the uniquely Australian frill-necked lizard, a reptile with fascinating defense mechanisms.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.desc: Fourth generation big cat tracker Boone Smith has worked in the harshest conditions imaginable, tracking the most elusive cats on the planet. But now he has a new mission that will bring us closer to the action than ever before. In Man v. Lion, only an inch of acrylic will separate Boone from one of the worlds top predators, bringing audiences closer to the African lion than they could ever imagine. The show follows Boone across the Nambiti Game Reserve as he breaks down each stage of a lion's kill. Boone tracks a lion coalition as they hunt and search for a mate, ultimately putting him face-to-face with these apex predators.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations

A severely dehydrated stray with feline leukemia steals hearts at the clinic, while another former stray needs eye surgery. The team helps two tiny kittens that were trapped underneath a hot car and an escaped cat recovering from an injury. A hairless sphynx cat has a concerning lump.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The docs at Critter Fixer lend a helping paw to a variety of canine clients. Fifteen small-town celebrity chihuahuas need updated shots after one of their own becomes ill, an adorable puppy steals hearts around the clinic, and another young dog has an unusually large growth. Dr. Hodges helps an Alaskan malamute get its travel papers and attempts to bring a Pomeranian back from the brink. The docs leap into action, trying to save a canine bit by a venomous snake, and perform an emergency C-section to deliver five bulldog puppies.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Kingdom of the White Wolf
programme.desc: Join Ronan Donovan, a National Geographic Explorer and photographer, as he takes the viewer on a unique adventure to track down the hard-to-find Arctic wolf. The series follows the year-long travails of a family of Arctic wolves on Ellesmere Island, from the first breaking light after the long winter, through the life-bringing springtime, the fattening summer months and the preparations of autumn. Each episode deals with different obstacles that the wolves face and have to overcome and, along the way, we the various characters and personalities of the animal family are revealed. The show makes good use of intimate footage to make the viewer feel that they are actually there, observing the creatures up close.

programme.title: The Rise of Black Wolf
programme.desc: In Yellowstone National Park, several wolf packs reside and compete for territory and pack leadership. A successful wolf pack survives by keeping order, respecting the hierarchy and obeying the leaders. But among these packs, a dark wolf with an unusual approach appears. Sometimes a loner, often a Casanova, eventually a leader- his surprising recipe for success broadens the definition of "normal" wolf behavior.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin journeys down Australia's rivers to find which riparian animal is most built to survive. His first encounter is with the duck-billed platypus, a peculiar and adorable monotreme, or egg-laying mammal. Phil then gets a grip on the ultra-slimy long-finned eel and learns of its extraordinary reproductive habits before finally catching a river-dwelling bull shark.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin wanders into Australia's woodlands to find the species most adapted for survival. Phil first encounters the yellow-bellied glider, an intrepid marsupial with a built-in wingsuit. Next is one of Australia's most abundant but deadly reptiles, the eastern brown snake. Last but certainly not least, Phil finds the iconic, cuddly and oh-so-sleepy koala.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: The highest mountains on Earth are home to snow leopards, golden eagles, mountain goats, barnacle goslings and gelada monkeys. But only the toughest can endure the extreme weather, scarce food supplies and limited oxygen on these peaks. Showcasing never-before-filmed animal behaviour using new technology to capture fresh angles and scales, Hostile Planet provides unique access to one of the most extreme environments on the planet.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects 1 million acres of diverse habitat. Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: HOSTILE PLANET is a ground-breaking wildlife series that explores Earth's most hostile environments. Over the course of six episodes, we explore the extremes of deep, high, cold, hot, wet and dry and reveal the truly extraordinary ways in which animals have adapted to survive in the face of great adversity. It's always been a HOSTILE PLANET and yet, in the last 40 years, it's got a whole lot tougher for the wildlife. The world has changed more in the last 40 years than at any time in the last 65 million. So animals in the most hostile places on Earth must adapt in the blink of an evolutionary eye. Facing everything from intrinsically hostile habitats and brutally punishing weather to the unrelenting threat of predators and intense competition for resources, their challenge is simple: adapt or die.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Zion's iconic landscapes feature soaring red spires against a clear blue sky. Beyond canyons and cliffs, water emerges as a surprising force. The humble Virgin River, sculpting a geologic masterpiece over millennia, sustains diverse life in Zion National Park. Climbers, bighorn sheep, wild turkeys, and globe mallow bees all find refuge alongside this flowing lifeline.

Oceans are dynamic environments where animals must adapt to life of constant change. Discover how seals fend off sharks; how turtles risk their lives to create their next generation; and how ingenious orca fight to survive in the face of ever-increasing competition.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Step inside the most frigid habitat known to Earth - the poles. Here, the planet's ultimate survivalists include whale-hunting polar bears, leopard-seal dodging penguins and a pack of Arctic wolves that bring down a pair of musk oxen. Polar species have evolved bodies and behaviours that help them combat the intense hostility of their habitats. But now, their world is changing so fast - literally breaking apart under their feet - and their resilience will be tested beyond the extreme.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Plenty of water, warmth and light provide perfect conditions for life to thrive and make the jungles the most diverse lands on Earth. But make no mistake, this is no Eden - from Jaguars to Gibbons, Hummingbirds to Orangutans, meet the incredible animals to discover why their struggles for survival in this crowded and competitive world have never been tougher. As jungle seasons become more unpredictable only the toughest animals will triumph.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi National Park spans over 3,000 square miles of western Tanzania. Lions, hippos and crocodiles live in harmony, until an unusual climatic cycle turns the normal dry season into an extreme drought. Lion cubs face mortal danger from a rogue male lion intent on a takeover, hippos fight viciously for dwindling river territory, and even the crocodiles struggle to survive until the rains arrive.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi's wetlands are unrecognizable in a prolonged drought, reduced to fetid, overcrowded mud wallows. At last, rains resurrect the river, inch by inch. Tensions wash away as hippos and crocodiles rejoice in the return of deep water … but flooding traps lion cubs in a precarious position. Normality will finally return to Katavi, but amidst global climate change, for how long?

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The polar bear is the world's largest land predator-but it's born blind and deaf. How does a helpless cub become a successful killer? Built for the Kill: Polar Bear exposes real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail. The cub spends about three years at its mother's side, learning to navigate the harsh Arctic environment.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The killer whale is the world's biggest dolphin-32 feet long and up to six tons heavy. Smart, sophisticated, and social, they live in groups and hunt cooperatively. But it's no natural born killer. Calves spend several years at their mother's side, learning how to hunt some of the smallest-and biggest-animals in the sea. Built for the Kill: Killer Whale exposes real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Life in the African bush is a game of survival, for both hunter and hunted. Add babies to the mix and you'll see astounding feats of courage as mothers risk life and limb to protect their young. In spring, tall grass helps babies hide out of sight, but it also camouflages predators on the prowl. This game drive captures extraordinary behaviour as families and individuals battle to eat, defend, and raise young.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

This safari gives you a front row seat to witness the explosive action of every surprise encounter.

programme.title: Killer Safari

programme.title: Shark vs Whale
programme.desc: A routine drone survey turns deadly when Ryan Johnson, a marine biologist based in South Africa, films a humpback whale being attacked and strategically drowned by a Great white shark. This is a total perspective shift on a creature he's spent his life studying. To make sense of this event, Ryan follows Humpback whales on their migration, mapping their weak spots. He also takes a new look at Great White sharks. How do they become whale killers?

programme.title: Shark vs Predator
programme.desc: Rare and remarkable instances of predation on sharks by a variety of species, capture by both daring photographers and unlikely bystanders, have given us new insight as to how the primacy of an apex predator can be challenged. We will analyze this growing body of footage with the aid of experts in the field, shedding light on how and why these events occur. Whether with talons, tentacles, or teeth, animals are hunting sharks all over the world.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Bundeslyga. „Hamburger SV“ - Miuncheno "Bayern"
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: La Liga. Madrido „Real“ - Madrido „Rayo Vallecano“
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Strasbūro RC - Paryžiaus „Saint-Germain“
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: Sean Connery e Alec Baldwin nel primo film dedicato all'agente della CIA, Jack Ryan. 1984: un sottomarino atomico diventa l'altissima posta in gioco nella Guerra Fredda tra Usa e Urss.

programme.title: Amore, cucina e curry
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Chocolat", commedia sull’arte culinaria con Helen Mirren. Preoccupata dalla concorrenza, una chef dichiara guerra a un bistrot indiano. Ma sottovaluta il talento del rivale.

programme.title: Poveri ma ricchi
programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

programme.title: Inside Man: Most Wanted
programme.desc: Un gruppo di criminali rapina la banca federale americana, dando inizio a un sequestro di dieci ore. Un esperto di negoziazione e un agente federale collaborano per salvare gli ostaggi e impedire la rapina.

programme.title: La legge della notte
programme.desc: Ben Affleck dirige e interpreta un noir ambientato negli anni del proibizionismo. Un veterano della Prima guerra mondiale ripudia gli insegnamenti del padre diventando un criminale.

programme.title: Il ciclone
programme.desc: In un paesino della Toscana vive la famiglia Quarini, il padre Osvaldo e i tre figli Levante, Libero e Selvaggia. Un giorno una compagnia spagnola di flamenco arriva e porta nuovo e contagioso entusiasmo nella vita dei quattro.

programme.title: Gomorra: Le origini
programme.desc: Pietro e Imma fanno i conti con quanto accaduto la notte precedente. Mentre Angelo sembra aver ottenuto finalmente tutto ciò che vuole. Con sottotitoli.

programme.title: Face/Off - Due facce di un assassino
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage e John Travolta in un thriller travolgente del maestro John Woo. Con una innovativa tecnica chirurgica, un agente dell'FBI 'indossa' la faccia del terrorista Castor Troy, responsabile di numerosi attentati e finito in coma dopo un incidente. Assumendone l'identita', vuole farsi rivelare dal fratello di Castor il nascondiglio di una bomba micidiale che si annida nel cuore di Los Angeles. Ma quando Castor si risveglia, costringe il chirurgo a trapiantargli la faccia dell'agente creando cosi' uno sbalorditivo rovesciamento di ruoli...

programme.desc: Il sapore del cinema classico in un'impeccabile spy-story sull'arte dell'inganno con Brad Pitt e Marion Cotillard, diretti da Robert Zemeckis. 1942: l'ufficiale franco-canadese Max Vatan e la militante della Resistenza francese Marianne Beausejour si innamorano dopo aver compiuto una missione: l'uccisione dell'ambasciatore tedesco a Casablanca. L'armonia della loro love story viene però incrinata dal sospetto: Max Vatan viene infatti informato dai suoi superiori che Marianne potrebbe essere una spia al soldo dei nazisti. Dallo sceneggiatore de "La promessa dell'assassino", Steven Knight.

programme.desc: Commedia romantica con Will Smith, Eva Mendes e Kevin James. Un esperto in seduzione e' bravo a dare i giusti consigli agli altri, ma non riesce ad aiutare se stesso.

programme.desc: L’indimenticabile Audrey Hepburn nei panni di una provinciale in scalata sociale a New York. Al suo fianco George Peppard in un’epocale commedia romantica diretta da Blake Edwards.

programme.desc: Coppa Volpi a Pierfrancesco Favino, diretto da Claudio Noce in una storia ispirata alla sua vita. Roma, 1976: Valerio assiste all'attentato terroristico ai danni del padre magistrato.

programme.desc: Ralph Fiennes dirige Oleg Ivenko nella biografia del ballerino Rudolf Nureyev. Dall'infanzia in Urss alla richiesta di asilo politico a Parigi nel 1961: la vita di un'icona del XX secolo.

programme.desc: 3 premi Oscar 2022 al remake di Sian Heder premiato al Sundance. Ruby, unica udente in una famiglia di sordomuti, sogna un futuro nel canto ma non vuole lasciare i suoi cari.

programme.title: Saint Judy
programme.desc: Michelle Monaghan nella vera storia di Judy Wood, l'avvocato che ha cambiato la legge sul diritto d'asilo negli Usa. Assunta in uno studio di Los Angeles, si batte per una donna afgana.

programme.title: Le otto montagne
programme.desc: Miglior film ai David di Donatello e Premio della giuria a Cannes per la storia di amicizia tra Pietro (Luca Marinelli) e Bruno (Alessandro Borghi) e il loro legame con la montagna.

programme.title: Barry Seal - Una storia americana
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Domhnall Gleeson in un action tratto da una storia vera. Un pilota accusato di narcotraffico viene reclutato dalla Cia per svolgere missioni sotto copertura in Centro America.

programme.desc: L’indimenticabile Audrey Hepburn nei panni di una provinciale in scalata sociale a New York. Al suo fianco George Peppard in un’epocale commedia romantica diretta da Blake Edwards.

programme.desc: Diretto da Ron Howard, un avvincente thriller basato su una storia vera con Jude Law e Vanessa Kirby. Dopo la crisi del 1929, il dottore e filosofo Friedrich Ritter decide di lasciare la Germania e di trasferirsi in un'isola remota delle Galapagos.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: 6 Oscar per il capolavoro di Kathryn Bigelow con Jeremy Renner protagonista. In Iraq, una squadra di artificieri statunitensi viene inviata sul posto per una pericolosa missione.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: Speciale - Gomorra - Le Origini
programme.desc: Tutti i segreti del dietro le quinte di Gomorra Le Origini, la serie che racconta l’iniziazione criminale di Pietro Savastano.

programme.desc: 3 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Francis F. Coppola, con Marlon Brando e Al Pacino. Dopo l'attentato al padre, Mike comincia l'ascesa nella malavita a capo della famiglia Corleone.

programme.title: Le otto montagne
programme.desc: Miglior film ai David di Donatello e Premio della giuria a Cannes per la storia di amicizia tra Pietro (Luca Marinelli) e Bruno (Alessandro Borghi) e il loro legame con la montagna.

programme.desc: Diretto da Craig Gillespie, il financial drama che ripercorre il caso GameStop, l'azienda salvata da un gruppo di investitori amatoriali a discapito di un gruppo di speculatori di Wall Street.

programme.title: Colazione da Tiffany (Vers. Rest.)
programme.desc: L’indimenticabile Audrey Hepburn nei panni di una provinciale in scalata sociale a New York. Al suo fianco George Peppard in un’epocale commedia romantica diretta da Blake Edwards.

programme.desc: Edoardo Leo, Claudia Gerini e un grande cast italiano in un film di Liliana Cavani. Alcuni amici si trovano in una villa sul mare quando scoprono che un asteroide potrebbe colpire la Terra.

programme.title: Fuga in Normandia
programme.desc: Da una storia vera, l'ultimo film per Michael Caine prima del suo ritiro dalle scene e per l'indimenticabile Glenda Jackson. L'anziano Bernie fugge dall'ospizio per raggiungere la Francia e celebrare con gli altri veterani il 70esimo anniversario dello sbarco in Normandia.

programme.desc: Dal regista di "Charlie's Angels", un'emozionante storia vera con Matthew McConaughey. Dopo un tragico incidente, un allenatore fa di tutto per ricostruire la squadra di football.

programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek ritorna alla sua terra natale con tre cortometraggi. La musica, intorno alla tavola, aiuta a esprimere e condividere le emozioni.

programme.desc: Judi Dench nella storia di una spia del KGB. Sottoposta a interrogatorio, l'insospettabile vedova Joan Stanley ripercorre la sua lunga militanza al servizio del regime comunista.

programme.desc: La pellicola Sky Original di Jean-Jacques Annaud sull'incendio che colpi' la cattedrale parigina nel 2019 e su coloro che sfidarono le fiamme per mettere in salvo tesori inestimabili.

programme.desc: Sceneggiato dai fratelli Coen, war movie biografico di Angelina Jolie. Seconda guerra mondiale: reclutato in aviazione, l'atleta Louis Zamperini finisce in mano ai giapponesi nel Pacifico.

programme.title: Il Dono Piu' Prezioso
programme.desc: Mandato al campo di Auschwitz, un padre getta dal treno uno dei suoi figli gemelli. Un povero taglialegna raccoglie un pacco caduto nella neve e il piccolo fagotto si rivela essere ciò che aveva atteso con tanta impazienza.

programme.title: Di nuovo in gioco
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood, Amy Adams e Justin Timberlake in un film su padri e figli. Un anziano talent-scout del baseball ricuce il rapporto con la figlia mentre cerca un nuovo campione da lanciare.

programme.title: Il signore delle formiche
programme.desc: Gianni Amelio dirige Luigi Lo Cascio ed Elio Germano nella pellicola che ricostruisce la vicenda umana del caso Braibanti e il bigottismo dell'Italia degli anni 60.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.desc: Un ragazzo geniale, cresciuto da una madre amorevole, mette a repentaglio i propri successi e il proprio futuro per liberare il padre, che è in prigione. Questa sua rischiosa impresa mette alla prova i legami familiari e le ambizioni personali.

programme.title: La stanza accanto
programme.desc: Tilda Swinton e Julianne Moore in un dramma di Pedro Almodovar, Leone d'Oro a Venezia. Martha è una reporter di guerra malata di cancro che ha deciso di suicidarsi con una pillola. Ingrid, una sua amica di infanzia, passa con lei gli ultimi giorni prima del momento fatale.

programme.desc: Barbora Bobulova, Marie-Christine Barrault e Stefania Sandrelli nell'opera prima di Mimmo Verdesca. Una donna scopre di avere una grave malattia e di essere stata adottata. Per sottoporsi al trapianto che le salverà la vita, deve rintracciare la madre biologica.

programme.desc: Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson e Kim Basinger nella visionaria opera di Tim Burton. Il ricco Bruce Wayne si trasforma in Batman per arginare il folle Joker. Oscar alle scenografie.

programme.title: Batman - Il ritorno

programme.title: Maybe This Time
programme.desc: \"Steph Asuncion and Tonio Bugayong were once in love. Back then, she was a young girl who wanted a simple life and he was older, more ambitious than she was. Tonio was a small town guy who wants to board a ship to provide for his family’s furniture business. Sarah was a Manila girl who spends the summer in the province for community service. What might have been a sweet relationship ended sourly when Tonio left without saying goodbye. Steph was heartbroken and it taught her to dream bigger to be worthy of love. Will their paths cross again? Will they overcome the pains of the past to give love a second chance? This is a story between two people who will be reminded about the importance of being true to one’s self in order for true love to happen.\".

programme.title: A Glimpse of Forever
programme.desc: A LOVE TRIANGLE BETWEEN TWO PEOPLE. Can't find love in the real world? Try virtual dating.

programme.title: Status: Single

programme.title: Midnight
programme.desc:
Kyeong-mi (Jin Ki-joo), a deaf girl, works as a sign language counselor at the sign language call center. One night she witnesses So Jung-eun's (Kim Hye-yoon) stabbing and becomes a new target for the Jekyll and Hyde serial killer Do-sik (Wi Ha-joon). It now turns into a silent chase. Jong Tak (Park Hoon), So Jung-eun's brother, a security guard has to protect her sister. On the other hand Kyung-mi's deaf mother (Gil Hae-yeon) can do anything to protect her daughter.

[About]
Midnight is a 2021 South Korean thriller film, written and directed by Kwon Oh-seung. The film starring Jin Ki-joo, Wi Ha-joon and Kim Hye-yoon, depicts a life-threatening hide-and-seek scenario between a psychopathic killer and a deaf woman. The film was slated to release in 2020 but its release was postponed due to the resurgence of the COVID-19 pandemic. Finally the film was released simultaneously in theatres and via streaming media TVING on June 30, 2021. Midnight will be available on iQ.com from 18 September 2021.

[Source: Wikipedia]
